scope: 1 mm high by 10 mm wide sharp bump at 100 mm/s; B+S = 2 kg; true contact force error <= 0.5 N for the entire recording.
robotTravelMeasurement: Ideal plant travel supplied to the slow recentering loop; the fast voice-coil controller receives the modeled magnet measurement.

mismatchDefinitions.single_link_mismatch_1: Unmodeled physical force/back EMF constants at 90% nominal; observer keeps nominal constants.
mismatchDefinitions.single_link_mismatch_2: Unmodeled physical force/back EMF constants at110% nominal.
mismatchDefinitions.single_link_mismatch_3: Unmodeled current servo time constant increased25%.
mismatchDefinitions.single_link_mismatch_4: Unmodeled lower dynamic stiffness reduced10%, nominal preload offsets retained.
mismatchDefinitions.single_link_mismatch_6: B+S=1.8 kg; physical model and controller both recalibrated.
mismatchDefinitions.single_link_mismatch_7: B+S=2.2 kg; physical model and controller both recalibrated.
mismatchDefinitions.single_link_mismatch_8: Bump height increased20%; no surface-profile input to the controller.

scopeLimitations: Sensor noise/delay/bias tests use 50 N / 90 degrees, one stochastic seed.
Mass variants are recalibrated controller cases, not blind mass robustness.
One-factor passes are not a simultaneous worst-case tolerance-stack qualification.
The fully-rigid10kHz rows use the selected upper-rigid design weights on the fully-rigid model; they do not use the separately optimized fully-rigid controller.
This completed batch still used ideal travel in the slow recentering loop; the final dense measurement-only grid separately validates measured travel.
